# How each script is drawn from Noto into the 12 x 20 cell (decision E.77,
# docs/spec/design/languages.md section 5). The values were measured in the
# prototypes of October 2026.
#
# [script NAME]       a script; NAME matches the start of its characters'
#                     Unicode names (HEBREW, ARABIC, THAI ...); "latin"
#                     draws everything no other script claims
#   sources           source fonts of sources.txt, the first that has a
#                     character draws it
#   weight            the variable fonts' wght axis
#   hinting           "auto" (FreeType's automatic hinter) or "font" (the
#                     font's own instructions)
#   reference         letters whose ink sets the size ...
#   reference_height  ... this many lines tall ...
#   reference_width   ... and this many pixels wide (optional; without it
#                     the display's true proportions)
#   baseline          the cell line the baseline falls on, from 0 at the top
#   rtl, join         right-to-left shaping; carry joining strokes to the
#                     cell's edges (Arabic forms)
#   mark_row          marks are drawn at the bottom or top of their own cell
#                     (Thai and Lao, decision E.80)
#
# [font NAME]         an output font, NAME.bdf
#   family, copyright the BDF properties
#   characters        "required" (every character of the engine's sets),
#                     "uses:SET", "except:SET,...", "forms:SET",
#                     "range:XXXX-YYYY", "list:..." (see convert.py)
#   scripts           the scripts that draw them

[script latin]
# Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and symbols: Bedstead's metrics, capitals from
# line 2 to line 15 as the engine draws Bedstead's.
sources = mono sans symbols symbols2 math
weight = 600
hinting = auto
reference = H
reference_height = 14
reference_width = 10
baseline = 16

[script hebrew]
sources = hebrew mono
weight = 600
hinting = auto
reference = ה
reference_height = 13
reference_width = 10
baseline = 16

[script arabic]
sources = naskh
weight = 500
hinting = font
reference = ا
reference_height = 12
baseline = 14
rtl = yes
join = yes

[script georgian]
# Mkhedruli is a script of one case with ascenders and descenders: the
# ascender letters stand as tall as Latin capitals.
sources = georgian
weight = 600
hinting = auto
reference = ბ
reference_height = 14
baseline = 16

[script armenian]
sources = armenian
weight = 600
hinting = auto
reference = Ա
reference_height = 14
reference_width = 10
baseline = 16

[script tifinagh]
sources = tifinagh
weight = 600
hinting = auto
reference = ⵏ
reference_height = 14
baseline = 16

[script thai]
# The Philips SAA5246AP/S convention (decision E.80): upper marks at the
# bottom of their cell, lower vowels at the top, for rows of their own.
sources = thai
weight = 800
hinting = auto
reference = กคนมบ
reference_height = 10
reference_width = 10
baseline = 15
mark_row = yes

[script lao]
sources = lao
weight = 800
hinting = auto
reference = ກຄນມບ
reference_height = 10
reference_width = 10
baseline = 15
mark_row = yes

[font noto-teletext]
family = Noto Teletext
copyright = Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors
# Required, and Vietnamese precomposed letters (REQ-CHR-014).
characters = required range:1EA0-1EF9 except:G0_Thai,G0_Lao,G2_Thai,G2_Lao,G0_Persian,G0_Urdu,G0_Pashto,G0_Sindhi,G0_Sorani,G0_Uyghur,G0_Balochi,G0_ArabicPlain
scripts = latin hebrew arabic georgian armenian tifinagh

[font noto-teletext-arabic]
# The Arabic-script sets of group 1001, joined by the receiver: their
# letters, digits and punctuation, and every joined form (REQ-CHR-015).
family = Noto Teletext Arabic
copyright = Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors
characters = uses:G0_Persian uses:G0_Urdu uses:G0_Pashto uses:G0_Sindhi uses:G0_Sorani uses:G0_Uyghur uses:G0_Balochi uses:G0_ArabicPlain forms:G0_Persian forms:G0_Urdu forms:G0_Pashto forms:G0_Sindhi forms:G0_Sorani forms:G0_Uyghur forms:G0_Balochi forms:G0_ArabicPlain
scripts = latin arabic

[font noto-teletext-thai]
# Thai and Lao (REQ-CHR-016), with Latin English for the pages' second set.
family = Noto Teletext Thai
copyright = Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors
characters = uses:G0_Thai uses:G0_Lao uses:G2_Thai uses:G2_Lao uses:G0_Latin_English
scripts = latin thai lao
